title: Lead
description: A candidate for investigation: one or more detector signals judged (deterministically, by risk_score + threshold — see docs/detection/rules.md) to be worth pursuing. See docs/contracts/leads.md.

signals.description: detector_signal signal_id values backing this lead.

status.description: OPEN: created, not yet acted on. FOLLOWED: the agent investigated it. DISCARDED: deliberately not pursued (discard_reason required).

discard_reason.description: Required and citable when status is DISCARDED — never 'the model decided'. See docs/investigation/protocol.md.
